provenance.target: 192.168.0.70 (DHCP; the desk the 2026-09-22 capture reached at 192.168.0.226)
provenance.firmwareSource: the desk's own identify answer on 51326 (7f 02 0c 000000 02 01 06 01 ...), as in the 2026-09-22 capture
provenance.recordedBy: macOS dev machine, scratch scripts (passive listener, NRPN get probe, native switch timer importing src/main/desk/frames.ts)
provenance.purpose: Whether highest-wins DCA resolution is buildable: can the desk report DCA levels and mutes, and how fast does a membership switch land.

measured: DCA 1 level is NRPN 4F 20 on MIDI channel 1 (TCP 51325), 14-bit (CC06 MSB, CC26 LSB), 0..16383; the desk transmits it unasked while the fader moves, about every 18 ms on a slow move.
A fast DCA 1 pull from 14907 to 0 arrived as 27 messages in 114 ms. The bottom of travel steps 3442 -> 0 with nothing between: 0 is -inf.
DCA 1 mute is NRPN 02 00, value 1 on / 0 off, one message per press.
Input 1 to LR is NRPN 40 00 (the published parameter), as a cross-check on the decoding.
Removing input 1 from DCA 1 and re-adding it at the desk produced no MIDI at all: membership changes are not reported on 51325.
An NRPN get (B0 63 mm, B0 62 ll, B0 60 7F) is answered with the parameter echoed and its value within 5-40 ms, for 4F 20-27 and 02 00-07.
DCA 2 is 4F 21: it read 10289 with the fader at about -40 dB and 0 at -inf. DCAs 3-8 (4F 22-27) read 0 at -inf; DCA mutes 02 00-07 read 0 (off).

4F 00-07 read 15196 (76 5C) and 4F 08 read 15213 (76 6D) with the aux masters at their reset 0 dB; 4F 09-0C did not answer. A DCA and an input set to 0 dB by hand read 15120-15165 and 15135-15150: neighbouring steps of the same table near the top of travel (about 15-17 per step).
The desk takes one MIDI TCP client: a second connection to 51325 was reset at once while the passive listener held one, and accepted once it was gone.

On 51326, with Cuerunner's own session frames, a membership switch written as assign-new, flag, clear-old, flag and then a hello was followed by the hello's answer in 3.5-7.6 ms over ten switches. The desk sent no frame that answers the membership itself; its 7f 08 pushes kept their own cadence (61 B about every 500 ms, 165 B about every second).
TCP 51321 refused connections on this desk before any session was opened, so no BYE. could be sent; a hello on 51326 a few seconds after the session ended was still answered in 14 ms.
inferred: DCAs 2-8 are 4F 21-27 and their mutes 02 01-07 (DCA 2 level measured moving; the rest only read at rest).
Unity is 15196 (76 5C), from eight masters at their reset value; which of 4F 00-08 is LR and which are auxes 1-8 is not established here.
The hello answer bounds when the desk had read the membership frames, assuming it reads its socket in order; when the audio follows is not measured.
open: Visual confirmation at the desk that input 1 moved between DCA 1 and DCA 2 on each switch.
Whether a make-before-break switch (briefly on both DCAs, offsets summed) or break-before-make (briefly on none, at the channel fader alone) is audible; needs an audio capture.
Why 51321 refused, and whether the 2026-09-22 mute-after-no-goodbye measurement still holds on this desk.

midiPassive.note: Every MIDI byte from 51325 during the gestures, as [ms, hex] per message. Gestures in order: DCA 1 slow 0->max->0; DCA 1 mute on/off; input 1 down then up; DCA 1 fast up then pull to -inf; input 1 removed from and re-added to DCA 1 (silent).

nativeSwitch.note: Input 1 switched DCA 1 -> DCA 2 and back five times, 1.5 s apart, then left on DCA 1 only. deskFrames.dt is ms after the write.
